courses.synopsis: Probability: random variables, distribution and density functions, expectations. Rectangular, binomial, Poisson functions. Central Limit Theorem. Continuous and discrete random variables. Sampling from populations, random numbers, and sampling distributions. Estimation of parameters; point and interval. Hypothesis and significance tests; testing equality of means and proportions. Use of CHI square, and t-tests. Analysis of variance, fitting of curves. Regression: least squares fit, correlation.
